gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-ranade: Ranade moves with a faint nib-pressure wobble in its round letters, stroke ends set far apart and the line spread wide. Baloo Bhaina 2 does loud best; Ranade does soft, spread-out lines best.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-supreme: Crisp letters held open, never curled shut, give the text a thick, heavy-looking strip through the middle. Supreme holds the steady text best, while Baloo Bhaina 2 does bold, distinctive display best.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-general-sans: Baloo Bhaina 2 flares the terminals of its s wide apart and carries a high-set x-height. While General Sans handles text with steady pen pressure, Baloo Bhaina 2 takes the loud display work.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-manrope: Wide-set terminals on the s give Baloo Bhaina 2 its bold, distinctive look and a high-set x-height. And Manrope steps in with bright open curves and one line width, a soft landing after the loud top.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-satoshi: Bold up top, wide open below: Baloo Bhaina 2 spreads its s terminals while Satoshi lifts a soaring x-height. Best of all is the step from distinctive lettering to flat, unmodulated lines.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-switzer: Switzer draws tubular, wire-like letters with c tips that never creep toward touching and a tall waist line. Baloo Bhaina 2 handles bold, distinctive display best, while Switzer handles the approachable text best.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-work-sans: Loud meets modern: Baloo Bhaina 2 spreads its s terminals wide, while Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart. And a long run of it would move steadily, joins sturdy and the mean line held high.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-archivo: Baloo Chettan 2 magnifies everything, with wide channels leading into each counter. Archivo's curves open outward and its x-height commands the line, so a long stretch of it feels editorial yet approachable.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-fs-asap: Expressive from the first line, Baloo Chettan 2 magnifies its text with wide channels leading into each counter. Asap stays readable, with c forms like open arcs and a body height nearly matching its capitals.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro draws strokes like a bent steel rod, with curve endings that never get near each other. Be Vietnam Pro's finest trait is its contrast-free line, a quiet floor under Baloo Chettan 2.
